newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo to sell $11.5 mln worth of vaccines to India.
newsitem.headline: Yugo to sell $11.5 mln worth of vaccines to India.

text.p: Yugoslavia's biggest vaccine and serum producer Zavod za imunologiju i virusologiju Torlak of Belgrade will sell $11.5 million worth of vaccines to India this year, Belgrade daily Politika said Friday.

Torlak director Tomislav Jankovic was quoted as saying that the company signed two deals worth $10 million with a large Indian vaccine producer and was about to conclude a $1.5 million contract with another private Indian firm.
He said Torlak had earned some $6 million in 1996 from sales to a large Indian state producer of vaccines, but gave no details.

At the moment, Torlak makes all vaccines included in the World Health Organisation vaccination programme with the exception of the vaccine for hepatitis. It also has other products such as immunology tests and allergens. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 22 4305
